title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hello Tom, hope you and the family are doing well.

I am working on my preseason Top 15 prospects list today. Last midseason I had Campos #15. Where do you think he could elevate to? And are there any other international guys that you think are worthy of the Top 15 (de la cruz and the other kid who came over?) Off record, no quotes, just for my info

Hi Anthony! I hope all is well with you. Off the record, we are excited about what Campos can become. Missing a year of minor league baseball is a wild card for the top 15 list but I would consider him in our top 10. De La Cruz and Reyes are also worthy to be in the top 15.
